description: Delete a comment on a post you published. It is deleted from the platform first and recorded as deleted in Chirpie only once that succeeded, so a comment is never reported gone while it is still public. On LinkedIn, and on Facebook, Instagram and Threads (coming soon), the platform deletes the replies under it too, and Chirpie records them deleted as well. Most platforms allow deleting only replies the account wrote; capabilities.delete_any from chirpie_list_comments says whether this one allows deleting somebody else's comment. A deleted comment cannot be restored.

post_id.description: Post ID the comment is on

name: chirpie_delete_comment
